sources.entry: MyTube ⚠ - Downloader and player for yt-dlp-supported sites with channel subscriptions, cloud upload support, and local library organization. (Demo) MIT Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: MyTube is a self-hosted downloader and player for YouTube, Bilibili, Twitch, MissAV and other yt-dlp-supported sites, with channel subscriptions and a local media library.
summary.what_it_does: It downloads videos from YouTube, Bilibili, Twitch, MissAV and other yt-dlp-supported sites via a URL input, including batch and parallel queued downloads. It also accepts local video uploads with automatic thumbnail generation. Channel subscriptions for YouTube, Bilibili and Twitch can fetch new content automatically, and videos can be organized into collections and played in a web UI. Other features named in the README include TMDB metadata scraping, automatic subtitles, private RSS feed links with filters, cloud upload to OpenList/Alist, password login with optional passkeys, read-only visitor accounts, and built-in Cloudflare Tunnel support for remote access.
use_cases: Download YouTube or Bilibili videos to a personal library
Auto-download new videos from favorite channels
Organize downloaded videos into collections and watch them in a browser
Share a read-only video library with visitors
Feed new videos into an external RSS reader
Upload videos to OpenList/Alist cloud storage after download
how_to_run: Copy backend/.env.example to backend/.env and adjust as needed
Docker: use the official image ghcr.io/franklioxygen/mytube:latest
Docker: use stacks/docker-compose.single-container.yml for a single-container deployment
Manual: requires Node.js 22.22+, 23.x, 24.x, 25.x or 26.x and npm v9+
See the Getting Started and Docker Deployment Guide docs linked from the README for full setup
notable: Built-in Cloudflare Tunnel support for remote access without port forwarding
D Mode for in-car playback using Canvas and WebCodecs
Optional live audio translation via Google Gemini Live
Admin-only 3x3 gesture login alongside password and passkey login
Task hooks running shell scripts at download start, success, fail and cancel
caveats: Node.js version must be within the supported ranges; unsupported versions fail during npm install, especially on Windows
Live audio translation streams video audio to Google's Gemini API when enabled
Downloading and playback of content is subject to local laws; the README includes a disclaimer restricting use to personal learning and research
keywords: save youtube videos to my server
